summary.frame_source: previous user-project 32x48 established swordsman sprite basis

limitations: Animations are pixel-authored prototype motions derived from the established 32x48 project sprites, not individually hand-illustrated frame-by-frame polished character art.
Death poses use transforms and require artistic review for anatomy.
Slash motion visual effect is isolated into a 64x64 5-frame layer and position synchronized via JSON, manual engine in-game tuning may be needed.
Tile room sample is a 2D quarter-view staging prototype, not a 3D/WebGL mesh or an actual map file.
Masks rely on color-region IDs and are prototype recolor channels; dynamic hair/skin integration remains for later batches.
